catalog.name: Pi
catalog.description: Run Pi with Claude, ChatGPT, and other model providers using Pi's own sign-in or API keys.
catalog.hint: Includes sandbox tools through MCP, mid-turn steering, effort control, and slash commands.

steps: Add Pi, then rebuild from Sandbox > Environment to install its CLI. Until then the card shows that a rebuild is needed.
Open Sign in on the Pi card to start Pi in the terminal. Run /login and choose your provider, or supply API keys in Environment below.
For Claude Pro/Max, run /login anthropic and choose subscription sign-in. If the browser cannot return to this sandbox, paste the redirect URL or code into Pi when prompted.
Claude subscription sign-in in third-party harnesses uses paid extra usage, billed per token, rather than the plan's included allowance.
Choose the default model with /model, then exit Pi. Select Pi in the chat's model picker; it uses that model and Pi's saved sign-in.
